## Checklist
- [ ] No installer, game file, archive, key or log is included.
- [ ] Any log or screenshot has user names and home-folder paths removed.
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q` pass, with the versions CI pins.
- [ ] Docs and the CHANGELOG are updated where behaviour changed.
- [ ] It does not add downloads, installer search, cracks or activation bypasses.
- [ ] I say only what I tested.
